correctness.rationale: PASS. Exact weighted-ball monomial decomposition gives radial T=|z|^2 distributed Beta(k+d,b), b=alpha+1; shell multiplicity binomial(k+d-1,d-1). Strict stochastic monotonicity orders eigenvalues. Scaling W=(k+d)(1-T) and domination of all logarithmic moments gives E log W=psi(b)+O(1/k), with exact log identity arctanh sqrt(T)=(log(k+d))/2+log(1+sqrt(T))-(log W)/2. Tail moments justify the two-term expansion for every p>0 including 0<p<1. Shell-weight log distribution contributes -1/d and partial-shell error is negligible; independently expanding arsinh filling and subtracting yields p/(2d)^p[log Gamma(b+d)/Gamma(b)-d psi(b)]. Strict Jensen psi(b)<log b plus Gamma(b+d)/Gamma(b)>=b^d proves positivity. Independent coefficient calculations for (d,alpha,p)=(1,0,1),(2,0,1),(2,1.5,2),(3,-.5,.5), and inspection of finite-N quadrature diagnostics, corroborate but do not prove asymptotic.
